doc.summary: MCP tool ``lazyown_auto_loop`` (single runner, one path with the CLI).
doc.description:
Routes through :func:`modules.lazy_runner.run_loop_command` — the same
runner behind the ``auto_loop`` and ``lazy_loop`` CLI verbs — so MCP runs
receive the full gate set: budget confirmation, preflight, bootstrap,
terminal safety, loop audit and the proxy/browser-sync autostart.

name: TOOL
value: types.Tool(name='lazyown_auto_loop', description='Autonomous loop over the single LazyOrchestrator engine (same runner as the auto_loop CLI). Accepts target, objective, rounds, workers and a wall-clock timeout; the runner covers budget confirmation, preflight, bootstrap, scope guards, chain steering, loop audit and honest failure handling. The legacy flag is accepted for compatibility and only annotates the output.', inputSchema={'type': 'object', 'properties': {'target': {'type': 'string', 'description': 'Target IP or hostname. Defaults to rhost from payload.json.'}, 'objective': {'type': 'string', 'description': 'Goal for the orchestrator task. Defaults to gaining initial access on target.'}, 'rounds': {'type': 'integer', 'description': 'Maximum orchestrator rounds (default 6, clamp 50).'}, 'workers': {'type': 'integer', 'description': 'Concurrent workers per round (default 2, max 5).'}, 'timeout': {'type': 'number', 'description': 'Whole-run wall-clock deadline in seconds (0 = unlimited).'}, 'legacy': {'type': 'boolean', 'description': 'Compatibility flag; only annotates the output.'}}, 'required': []})
